load_models: load sender models from a checkpoint and metadata file for evaluation on a given device
create_LinearClassifier: create a LinearClassifier with a specified input and output dimension for classification tasks
test_epoch: test a classifier against multiple sender models over a validation dataloader and return accuracies
run_transfer_classification: run transfer classification on a model and dataset to compute overall classification accuracy
review_transfer_classif: review the transfer classification sanity check module for sender model evaluation and classifier testing
